documented_timing_boundaries.silicon_behavior: Per-area CS*WCR wait-states stall external bus reads/writes cycle-by-cycle; SDRAM refresh steals bus cycles.
documented_timing_boundaries.core_behavior: CS*WCR/CS*BCR/SDCR/RTCSR/RTCNT/RTCOR registers enforce exact CPU73050.dll masks, 0xA55A write-keys, and refresh CMF counter ticks, but memory accesses complete atomically within the instruction step without bus stall cycles.
documented_timing_boundaries.impact: Zero impact on Casio OS 3.80 / MicroPython / standard .g3a add-ins; only observable by homebrew overclocking/memory-timing microbenchmarks.

documented_timing_boundaries.silicon_behavior: FRQCR KICK triggers hardware PLL relock delay (~hundreds of us) and changes bus/peripheral divider ratios dynamically.
documented_timing_boundaries.core_behavior: FRQCR KICK self-clears immediately, EffectiveCpuClockHz() computes exact IFC/SFC/BFC/PFC ratios, and MSTPCR0..2 actively gates module clocks (e.g., TMU freeze proven), without analog PLL lock transient delay.
documented_timing_boundaries.impact: Fully compatible with OS 3.80 clock-scaling & Ptune-style probing; analog PLL lock transient is idealized.

documented_timing_boundaries.silicon_behavior: DMA channels transfer bursts across multiple bus cycles interleaved with CPU execution.
documented_timing_boundaries.core_behavior: DMAC0 executes channel transfers synchronously on CHCR.DE write (with exact alignment checks -> DMAOR.AE, round-robin arbitration, CHCR bitmasks, and TC/DEI IRQs).
documented_timing_boundaries.impact: Zero impact on LCD/RAM DMA transfers; mid-DMA partial transfer observation is atomic.

documented_timing_boundaries.subsystem: TMU / ETMU / CMT / WDT / RTC Timer Granularity
documented_timing_boundaries.silicon_behavior: Hardware timers tick continuously on Pphi / 32.768 kHz RTCCLK asynchronously to CPU pipeline stages.
documented_timing_boundaries.core_behavior: Timers advance deterministically from retired instruction cycle counts on each StepInstruction() and AdvanceCycles() call; guarantees 100% bit-exact determinism across runs and threads.
documented_timing_boundaries.impact: Deterministic and reproducible; sub-instruction asynchronous race timing is quantized to instruction boundaries.

documented_timing_boundaries.silicon_behavior: Cache misses incur multi-cycle SDRAM line-fill stalls; IC/OC tags serve data directly.
documented_timing_boundaries.core_behavior: ShCacheUnit tracks authentic 4-way tags/valid/dirty bits, LRU eviction, ICBI/OCBI/OCBP/OCBWB stats, and 16 KB OCRAM (0x7C000000), while fetches execute with constant architectural cycle accounting.
documented_timing_boundaries.impact: Functional cache/OCRAM semantics are exact; cycle-level cache-miss latency profiling is not modeled.

documented_timing_boundaries.impact: Matches Casio OS 3.80 and Manager PLUS display/storage behavior; physical flash erase duration is accelerated by default.
